prompt: Last week someone added a 40 MB screenshot to the docs and the upload to Confluence timed out. Please add a size check for image files that get attached to a page, so oversized ones are caught when we convert. Add a test.
oracle: When we add a size check for images, the limit is 7 MiB (7,340,032 bytes), and a bigger image should only log a warning, never stop the conversion.
